scope: One finite final review of the two observed defects: future capacity timing promoted into current window and abstract supply-pressure increase mistaken for physical supply increase. The explicit metadata source-index route closes the earlier compressed-facts identity false positive.

finite_assessments.reason: An alias is resolved only through one trusted metadata source_index entry to its unique original context record and matching version when present. Nonempty original title and full uncompressed notice text containing MessageID/Event must exactly match before borrowing. Compressed reason/remarks, same facility, same capacity, alias order, hidden attributes and model fields are not identity evidence.

Both sources must be known by as_of and the matching originals must have one complete normalized UTC interval with end after start. Missing index/title/summary/fullnotice, altered message/current interval, future-known source, or conflicting intervals cannot lend a clock. Reordering the context rows does not alter source-ID binding. The exact original manual copy can borrow its real original future interval.

The future7.6notice cannot physically reduce current-window capacity, including a plan explicitly put inside the wrong window. Publication/forecast occurring in the window and an effect explicitly dated届时 remain distinct and allowed. A future capacity risk may affect current futures pricing; this rule does not requireflat.

The new abstract supply-pressure/constraint object mask removes the spurious physical increase hint while retaining genuine later supply/demand/inventory changes. It introduces no flow quantity, direction enum or result assignment. The original correct bullish constraint phrase no longer receives that false physical-sign diagnostic; its unrelated true flow-zero error still rejects the draft.

Fresh analyze and complete diagnostic collection explicitly pass the existing meta.source_index. It is not added to model JSON. The three-argument public validator API remains compatible and conservatively does not borrow a clock without index.
